name: Purgation Isle
summary: Condemned spirits haunt Purgation Isle, off Hillsbrad’s southern coast. Tombstones and a ruined watchtower mark its winding paths, where fallen humans and dwarves wander without peace.

sections.title: A Haunted Sanctuary
sections.body: Purgation Isle rises from the sea south of Hillsbrad, its winding paths passing tombstones and an abandoned watchtower. No living nation claims the isle. Condemned souls roam among the graves. They were paladins, priests, mages, and judges, and death has brought them no peace.

sections.title: Dark Associations
sections.body: Dark spellcasters have taken an interest in the condemned souls of Purgation Isle. The ogre necromancer Kormok and others are said to delight in calling upon the anguished dead. They summon the spirits to do their bidding.

faq.answer: Purgation Isle lies in the bay off Hillsbrad Foothills’ southern coast, south of the mainland.
Powerful condemned spirits haunt Purgation Isle. They include cursed paladins, justiciars, clerics, acolytes, and writhing mages of human and dwarven descent.

faq.q: Who is Kormok and why does he care about this island?
faq.answer: Kormok is an ogre necromancer who mastered the summoning of Purgation Isle’s condemned spirits. Specialized dark artifacts helped him command them.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see cursed paladins and justiciars wandering Purgation Isle. Their plight is a somber reminder of holy defenders who fall to dark curses and are denied eternal rest.
As a dwarf, you know dwarven spirits haunt the cemetery. Your kin are bound to this lonely rock, far from the mountains of Khaz Modan.
